evidence: the increasing use by threat actors of artificial intelligence
adversaries are becoming more advanced, including nation-states and actors sponsored by or affiliated with nation-states
These techniques include, but are not limited to, the use of malicious software, destructive malware, ransomware, denial-of-service attacks, phishing and other means of social engineering
ai_positioning.summary: WWD adopte une posture défensive face à l'IA, mentionnant principalement les risques cybersécurité liés à l'utilisation croissante de l'IA par les acteurs malveillants pour compromettre ses systèmes et données sensibles de défense nationale.
